title: Furniture Image Dedup - Source Code
subtitle: 6-stage duplicate detector for furniture product images with a color gate
description:
Source code of **furniture-image-dedup** (https://github.com/georgewhba/furniture-image-dedup).

A production-grade tool that detects duplicate product images in a furniture e-commerce catalog using a six-stage funnel:

1. Exact hash (SHA-256)
2. Perceptual hash (pHash + dHash)
3. CLIP ViT-B/32 embeddings + FAISS nearest-neighbour search
4. **Mandatory color-verification gate** (rembg background removal + K-means palette + CIE-Lab distance with Hungarian matching) to reject same-shape / different-color products
5. Union-find grouping + confidence scoring
6. Excel / CSV report

The tool never deletes or modifies images; it only produces a report for human review.

Use it from a notebook: add this dataset as input, unzip / copy `furniture-image-dedup` to `/kaggle/working`, add it to `sys.path`, then call `src.pipeline.run(...)`.
